messages:
maya: Quick PTQ sanity run on reranker-v2 (int8) — seeing weird casing sensitivity in relevance. NDCG@10 down 3.4% vs fp16; MRR down 2.1%. Only used calibration set of short queries (median 6 tokens). :thinking_face: Anyone seen this?
jordan: can you paste the eval slice metrics and sampling details?
maya: sure — here's the eval command and outputs (trimmed). Also note tokenizer lowercasing in preprocessing vs prod.
```
# eval cmd
./eval_rerank --model reranker-v2-int8 --calib calib_short.json --eval eval_holdout.json --metrics ndcg@10,mrr
# results (delta vs fp16)
ndcg@1: -1.2%
ndcg@10: -3.4%
mrr: -2.1%
calib_size: 512
median_query_len_calib: 6
median_query_len_eval: 14
```
kevin: @maya did you use tokenizer.do_lower_case=true in the calibration pipeline? That could explain casing shift.
maya: yep pipeline had do_lower_case true for calib but eval kept original case (we keep original for prod samples). Bug in the prep script.
arya: suggestion — recompute PTQ with mixed-case calibration, and also try recalibrating on longer-tail queries (stratified by len). Add a small 5% long-query oversample to the calibration set.
jordan: also try switching calibration metric from MSE to KL and/or using per-channel symmetric quant stats, maybe less sensitive to casing artifacts.
maya: starting a quick rerun now (mixed-case calib + stratified sample), will post ops-bot link.
ops-bot: PTQ run started for reranker-v2-int8 (job id r2-int8-20240610-01). Estimated 12m. Logs: https://ci.redwood/ci/r2-int8-20240610-01 
maya: quick update — initial mixed-case calib run cut ndcg loss to ~0.9% and mrr to ~0.3%. Looks promising. Still need full sweep across slices.
kevin: great. Also add a checklist item in onboarding: ensure tokenizer config parity between calib/eval/prod.
arya: and add a small unit test that compares tokenized outputs across the three pipelines for a handful of real queries to catch regressions early.
jordan: can we mark this as likely a calibration-parity false positive for rollback? Not critical now but worth tracking.
maya: created ticket INF-2387 for calibration parity + PTQ re-run. Will attach full logs and the release notes diff. :memo:
